Home network VLAN plan

Split the home network into three VLANs on the router: trusted laptops and phones, IoT devices such as smart plugs and cameras, and a guest network.

Firewall rules

IoT devices may reach the internet but not the trusted VLAN. The trusted VLAN may open connections to IoT devices for control. The guest Wi-Fi is isolated from both.

Switch ports

The access point carries all three VLANs tagged on one trunk port. The NAS stays on the trusted VLAN.
